product_metadata.title: Kids Weighted Blanket 5 Lbs 36x48 inch for Toddler Kids Twin Size Bed Cotton Heavy Blanket
features: Oeko-Tex certified: Our products are Oeko-Tex certified. We use high-quality hypoallergenic cotton to produce a softer and more breathable weighted blanket.

Unique Design: The 7-layer structure includes doubled cotton covers and two microfiber polyester fillings inside, the central part is heavy glass beads. Those exquisite constructions ensure durability for their weight and also the comfort of a blanket.

Low Leaking Risk: Glass beads are key to a functional weighted blanket, grid-like stitching helps keep the glass beads made to stay in place, which fixes the problem of leaking beads or the glass beads moving massively around inside.
Weight: Advises anyone to choose a weighted blanket that comes in at about 8% to 12% of the user’s body weight.
Relax: Weighted blankets are the best way to help poor sleepers get a good night's rest and more mainstream for anyone who wants to relax. joybest blanket lets everyone have a restful night of sleep.
